title: Run a live question from host to participant to stage
persona: A host presenting one live question while a participant answers from a second surface.
purpose: Exercise the actual session flow: host starts, participant joins and answers, host reveals, and the stage reflects the result.
outcome: The same session state is visible in the host, participant, and projector stage surfaces.
prerequisites: The walkthrough admin key is accepted by the local worker.

chapters.title: Start and open the host question
chapters.narration: This session is seeded through the same session API used by the product clients. We use the browser for the live interaction itself: start the session, then put the first question on stage.

actions.text: What should participants see during a live session?

chapters.title: Join as a participant and answer
chapters.narration: Now the participant enters with a session code. No account is required. The participant chooses the visible live question, and the browser confirms the answer without exposing host-only controls.

chapters.title: Reveal the result and check the stage
chapters.narration: Back on the host surface, the response is ready to reveal. We show results, then inspect the projector stage. The important contract is that the session state, not a duplicated local mock, drives both views.
